- [IRET.1.8] **TMS via refcount + dependency table.**
  Truth maintenance tracks logical-emit justifications
  as reference counts on derived facts. A dependency
  table maps each in-flight activation's ID to the list
  of logical facts it supports. When the activation ends
  (token retracted), each supported fact's refcount
  decrements; at zero the fact is retracted. Multiple
  activations supporting the same logical fact are the
  natural refcount > 1 case.
